 About the match
 On this page you can find the Kyoto Sanga FC vs Newcastle Jets match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 3, on Tuesday 27-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Kyoto Sanga FC lines up in a 3-4-2-1 led by Elias, while Newcastle Jets sets up in a 4-1-4-1 led by Burgess. Kyoto Sanga FC is led by head coach Ranko Popovic, while Newcastle Jets is managed by Mark Milligan. The match is played at Sanga Stadium by Kyocera.
